value.rationale: Observed richness and frequency-of-frequency counts are basic occupancy summaries. The theorem gives a complete finite-sample sign classification under the canonical uniform model, with a particularly interpretable singleton-positive/high-frequency-negative transition and an explicit asymptotic location. This is a natural structural relation among standard statistics rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
